description: Source code for a shader translator utility that compiles and processes shader files using the ANGLE project's ShaderLang library. It handles different shader types, output formats, and resource configurations, and includes a main function for command-line usage.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the shader translator command-line tool.

methods.name: FindShaderType
methods.description: Determines shader type (vertex, fragment, compute, geometry) based on filename extension.

methods.name: CompileFile
methods.description: Reads shader source from file and compiles it using the provided compiler handle.

methods.name: LogMsg
methods.description: Logs messages with a specific format.

methods.name: PrintVariable
methods.description: Prints details of a shader variable, including type, name, and array sizes.

methods.name: PrintActiveVariables
methods.description: Prints all active shader variables (uniforms, attributes, varyings, outputs).

methods.name: ReadShaderSource
methods.description: Reads shader source code from a file into memory.

methods.name: FreeShaderSource
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for shader source code.

methods.name: ParseGLSLOutputVersion
methods.description: Parses GLSL output version from string.

methods.name: ParseIntValue
methods.description: Parses an integer value from string with default fallback.
